This is a placeholder vignette showing the expected shape of an entry in the [Vignettes](../vignettes.qmd) listing: a short, self-contained exploration of one idea, question, or pattern in the data — not a full analysis or paper.

To add your own vignette:

1. Copy this file to a new name in `vignettes/` (e.g. `vignettes/dbh-vs-height.qmd`).
2. Update the `title`, `author`, `date`, and `description` in the front matter above — these are what show up in the listing.
3. Replace this text with your own write-up. You can pull the underlying data from `data/dataset.json`, `data/sector-summary.json`, `data/species-composition.json`, or `data/biomass-points.json` (see the [Sector Explorer](../explorer.qmd) source for examples of reading them with `{ojs}`), or from `data/Placencia_mangroves_2025.xlsx` directly in R or Python.

Keep it simple — a chart or two with a paragraph of interpretation is plenty.
